sources.entry: Pika - An open-source color picker app. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/superhighfives/pika) [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/pika/id6739170421?platform=mac)

summary.name: Pika
summary.one_liner: Pika is an open-source, native colour picker app for macOS that finds on-screen colours and checks them against WCAG and APCA accessibility standards.
use_cases: pick a colour from anywhere on screen
check text and background contrast for accessibility
copy colour values in hex, RGB, HSL or OKLCH
compare two colours side by side
automate colour picking from scripts or other apps
find pixel-exact colours with a magnified loupe
summary.what_it_does: Pika lets you pick colours from anywhere on screen using a magnified loupe that shows the exact pixel under the cursor, and lets you nudge the pick one pixel at a time with the arrow keys. It shows WCAG and APCA compliance, including contrast ratio and lightness contrast, along with the text sizes each level suits. Colours can be copied in seven formats (Hex, RGB, HSB, HSL, LAB, OpenGL, OKLCH), and every pick is saved to a history you can revisit or undo. Pika can also be driven by a pika:// URL scheme for scripts and other apps, and it works in sRGB or Display P3 gamut.
notable: Accessibility checks for WCAG and APCA contrast with text size guidance
pika:// URL scheme for automating picks, copies and format changes
Magnified loupe with pixel-level nudging and Display P3 wide gamut support
caveats: Colour name lists from color.pizza need network access; a bundled list works offline
